name: Structural Engineering
focus: Designing the load-bearing skeleton of buildings, bridges, and towers: concrete, steel, and seismic design.
typical_roles: Structural design offices, consulting firms (e.g. Dar Al-Handasah, Khatib & Alami), contractors, JEA-licensed design engineer
tools: ETABS, SAP2000, SAFE, AutoCAD, Robot Structural Analysis

name: Geotechnical Engineering
focus: Soil and rock behavior, foundations, retaining structures, slope stability, ground improvement.
typical_roles: Soil-testing labs, foundation contractors, consulting offices, ministries (Public Works)

name: Construction Management & Site Engineering
focus: Running the execution of projects on site: planning, scheduling, cost, quality, HSE.
typical_roles: Contracting companies (e.g. Consolidated Contractors, local contractors), project management consultancies, site engineer/PM roles
tools: Primavera P6, MS Project, AutoCAD, BIM 360

name: Transportation & Highway Engineering
focus: Road, highway, and traffic design; pavement design; traffic studies.
typical_roles: Ministry of Public Works & Housing, Greater Amman Municipality, transportation consultants
tools: AutoCAD Civil 3D, Autodesk InfraWorks, HCS/Synchro (traffic), Bentley OpenRoads

name: Water Resources & Environmental Engineering
focus: Water supply, sewage networks, irrigation, hydrology, wastewater treatment.
typical_roles: Ministry of Water & Irrigation, Jordan Valley Authority, water utility companies (Miyahuna), environmental consultancies

name: Surveying & Geomatics
focus: Land surveying, GIS, topographic mapping, setting out, GPS/total-station work.
typical_roles: Survey departments, Department of Lands & Survey, contractors, GIS-based consultancies
tools: AutoCAD Civil 3D, ArcGIS/QGIS, Total Station software, Leica/Trimble tools

name: BIM & Digital Construction
focus: 3D model-based coordination across disciplines; clash detection; digital project delivery.
typical_roles: Large consulting/design firms, contractors adopting BIM mandates, BIM coordinator/manager roles

name: Quantity Surveying & Cost Estimation
focus: Measuring works, preparing BOQs, cost control, tendering, contract administration.
typical_roles: Contracting companies, consulting quantity-surveying offices, client-side cost control

name: Project Management (cross-discipline)
focus: Leading and controlling engineering projects: scope, schedule, budget, risk, stakeholders.
typical_roles: Any engineering/construction employer; PM and senior-engineer career progression
tools: MS Project, Primavera P6, PMI tools

name: Web / Full-Stack Development
focus: Building websites and web applications: front-end UI plus back-end logic, APIs, and databases.
typical_roles: Software houses (Estarta, Foothill, MenaITech, Zain Innovation Campus), startups, freelance/remote for international clients

name: Mobile App Development
focus: Native or cross-platform apps for iOS and Android.
typical_roles: App development agencies, in-house teams at telecoms/banks, freelance

name: Data Science & Analytics
focus: Extracting insight from data: statistics, visualization, predictive modeling.
typical_roles: Banks, telecoms (Zain, Orange, Umniah), consultancies, e-commerce platforms
tools: Python, SQL, Pandas, Power BI/Tableau, scikit-learn

name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
focus: Building models that learn from data: NLP, computer vision, deep learning.
typical_roles: R&D teams, startups, universities, international remote roles

name: Cybersecurity
focus: Protecting systems and data: penetration testing, security operations, governance/compliance.
tools: Kali Linux, Wireshark, SIEM tools, CEH/OSCP toolset

name: Cloud Computing & DevOps
focus: Designing, deploying, and automating infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines in the cloud.
typical_roles: Software houses, telecoms, enterprises migrating to cloud, remote roles for international companies
tools: AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins/GitHub Actions

name: Networking & Systems Administration
focus: Designing and maintaining network infrastructure and IT systems.
typical_roles: Telecoms (Zain, Orange, Umniah), banks, government IT departments, ISPs
tools: Cisco IOS, Windows Server/Linux, firewalls, VPNs

name: Database Administration & Data Engineering
focus: Designing, maintaining, and optimizing databases and data pipelines.

name: QA / Software Testing
focus: Ensuring software quality: manual and automated testing.
typical_roles: Software houses, outsourcing companies, product companies
tools: Selenium, Postman, JIRA, manual + automated testing frameworks

name: IT Project Management (cross-discipline)
focus: Leading and controlling software/IT projects: scope, schedule, budget, risk.
typical_roles: Any tech employer; PM career progression from senior developer/engineer
